ledger_standard: FrankBase Verified Purchase Review Ledger v1.0

governance.founder_manifesto: A real 2-star or 3-star review from an authentic buyer is infinitely more valuable than a million fake 5-star reviews.
governance.reward_policy: Unconditional 5% discount coupon issued to all verified reviews (1-Star to 5-Star identically). Zero fake badges. Zero rating coercion.
governance.anti_fraud_gate: Zero IP-blocking. 100% Purchase-Verification via Cloudflare D1 + Dodo Payments. Duplicate reviews for same SKU per buyer are rejected.
governance.privacy_compliance: Strict DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR Data Minimization. Buyer emails masked with zero PII exposure.

verified_reviews.review_text: Verified buyer review test: high quality craftsmanship and transparent ecosystem.
